## Keywords

{{< glossary promo-clip hook shot-list pacing call-to-action title-safe-area >}}

## 22.1 The parts of a promo

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A promo starts with a hook in the first 3 seconds.
- Short gameplay beats follow on the music.
- It ends with the logo and a call to action.
- **Do it:** Plan the five parts of your promo. What is your hook?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/promo-structure.png)
:::
::::

## Example · The plan of the promo

Salma needs a 30-second promo of Rooftop Rescue for the store page.
**What are its five parts?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The **hook** is the wave hitting the roof as Nour jumps.
2. The **world** and the **beats** show the town, the rowing, the net and the levels.
3. The **big moment** is Pasha safe on the roof, then the **logo** and "Play free now".
:::

## 22.2 A shot list

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- We mark the best moments of the capture first.
- A shot list gives each shot its time, content and length.
- Menus and loading screens stay out.
- **Do it:** Make all checks green in Promo Builder. Which shots did you remove?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/shot-list.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Shots

a) Which shot comes first in the promo?
b) Which shot comes last?
c) How long should the whole store promo be?

::: {.answer}
a) the hook, the wave hitting the roof
b) the logo with "Play free now"
c) 25–30 seconds
:::

## 22.3 Cutting the promo

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- We put the music on the timeline first.
- We cut the shots on the beats of the music.
- Titles show real features inside the safe area.
- **Do it:** Cut your promo on the beats. Where does the logo come?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/promo-structure.png)
:::
::::

## Example · Cutting on the beat

The music of the promo has a beat every 0.5 seconds.
**How does Tariq use it?**

::: {.reveal}
1. Tariq places **markers** on the beats.
2. Each level shot lasts **1.5 s**, which is three beats.
3. The giant wave comes with the **loudest part**, and the logo with the **last chord**.
:::

## 22.4 Review and export

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- We watch the promo as a player, with the checklist and on a phone.
- We fix what we find and export a new version.
- Many viewers watch on a phone without sound.
- **Do it:** Review your promo on a phone. What did you fix?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/promo-check.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Your advice (harder)

a) What do we advise for a promo that opens with a 5-second logo?
b) What do we advise for a title "The best game ever!!!"?
c) What do we advise for a famous song found online?

::: {.answer}
a) Start with the hook.
b) Show a real feature instead.
c) Use music that we are allowed to use.
:::

## Summary

- A promo has a hook, the world, beats, a big moment and a call to action.
- A shot list keeps only the shots that serve these parts.
- We cut on the beats, with honest titles in the safe area.
- We review on a phone and export a new version.
